citation.authors: Guberti M, Botti S, Capuzzo MT, Nardozi S et al

cited_by.title: Bovine colostrum supplements for immunity and gut health

record.population: Healthy and sick people in 28 papers (reviews, randomised trials, observational studies and case series)
record.design: Systematic review of bovine colostrum by every route of use
record.finding: Studies were highly varied in people, doses and risk of bias. As a supplement it showed "interesting effects" on upper respiratory illness in sportsmen, immune response and intestinal permeability. Results in children were conflicting, and there is little evidence in older adults.
record.note: A mixed bag by design, so it maps the field and tests no single claim.
